main_text.p: Paraphrases explicat Phrasi Rabbinicâ, נושאין ונותנין במקח וממכר. Item Elias in Meturgeman. Alii explicant per Examinare, Probare, quasi esset à טיר.
טְרִיתָא Ch. Mobile, movens, commovens se, quod facultatem & potentiam habet sese movendi, Deut.11. 6. in Targ. Jon. Respondet Hebraeo יָקוּם Substantia viva.
טָרִיתָא, Ch. Nomen piscis magni marini, Deut.33.19. in Targ. Jonath.

טרב טְרִיבָא, טְרִיב Ch. Adustio, inflammatio, Exo.2.5. in Jon. Sunt qui legunt שְׁרִיבָא, à שרב, Uri, Comburi. Si lectio prior proba est, potest deduci ab Hebraeo צָרֵבֶת, quod idem, per commutationem frequentissimam litterarum ץ & ט.
טרג טְרִיגוֹן Ch. Τείγων, trigonus, triangulus. Plur. טְרִיגוֹנִין Exo.39.10. in Targ. Jon. & 28.17. Vide quoq; infrà in טרך.

טָרַךְ Ch. Expellere, ejicere, extrudere, depellere, abigere: sic semel Syr. ܐܦܝܩ Et abegit eos, Act.18.16. Item Claudere, concludere, Genes. 20.18. in Targ. Hierosol. & Exo.14.3. Ithpeh. אִתְטְרַךְ Ejici, expelli, Prov.25.5. Genes.28.11. in T. Jon.
טָרִיר Ch. Expulsus, ejectus: מְטָרָא טְרִידָא Pluvia expulsa, impetuosa, Cant.2.11. Sic כֵּימָא דְטְרִיר Sicut mare expulsum, propulsum, id est vehementer commotum, Jesa.57.20.
מְטָרָא Ch. Occupatio, molestia, defatigatio, labor: Item nomen proprium viri, Matred, ab assiduo labore sic dicti, Genes. 36.39. in Targ. Jonath. & Hierosol. Solent
